wide.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one continuous ultrawide 8-bit pixel-art game background. Edit target: the supplied local DOE workshop image. Expand/outpaint this workshop horizontally into a 2304 x 1024 (9:4, ultrawide) composition, adding substantial integrated room to BOTH sides. Keep the existing three main exhibits fully visible in the middle: 01 / CONCEPT desk and pinned warrior sketches on the left, 02 / ASSEMBLY green hologram pedestal in the middle, 03 / FINAL framed DOE poster on the right. Preserve their design, labels, proportions, relative placement, and the original camera perspective. Continue the actual detailed artwork into the new sides: chunky industrial support columns, pipes, moss and hanging vines, cabinets, shelves, cables, wall vents, warm lamps, scattered workshop props, and continuous tiled floor with matching perspective and diagonal warm light. All surfaces across the ENTIRE wide image must have the same rich hand-crafted 8-bit pixel art, dithered texture, stepped contours, warm bronze and dark olive palette, black outlines, lime-green machinery highlights. The added side areas must have the SAME pixel size, lighting, texture density, and level of detail as the center, with invisible joins, never plain panels. Keep all three exhibit headings and overhead pipes within the image; do not crop them. Floor fills the bottom approximately 30 percent, with clear walkable space in the foreground and continuous tile lines across the entire width. The background should look like a single expansive room drawn by one artist. No player character, no people in the room, no borders, no sidebars, no framing, no buttons or UI. Exact poster art may remain as artwork displayed on the wall. Output a single ultrawide landscape image.

portrait.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: portrait 8-bit pixel-art workshop game background, target aspect 1:2, 1024x2048. Reference image: the provided ultrawide DOE workshop, use the SAME art direction, pixel size, colors, rich dithered materials and exhibit identity. Recompose/expand the workshop into one seamlessly integrated TALL portrait scene for a phone. Keep ALL THREE exhibit stations completely visible side-by-side across the middle-width of the room, grouped compactly: 01 / CONCEPT drawing desk at left, 02 / ASSEMBLY lime-green hologram in center, 03 / FINAL framed DOE warrior poster at right. Preserve legible short headings. Place their headings around 35 percent down from the top and their feet/base around 70 percent down; the exhibit group must stay entirely inside the middle 80 percent of the image width. Expand ABOVE them with beautifully detailed overhead copper pipework, industrial ceiling beams, dangling moss and vines, amber lamps, steel walls and small cabinets. Continue a unified perspective tiled workshop floor across the BOTTOM 30 percent, with warm diagonal window light, clear walkable foreground, and matching texture. The entire portrait image is continuous finished pixel art: absolutely no flat sidebars, no blank margins, no blurred fill, no panels from a different art style. Stepped chunky 8-bit edges, warm bronze/dark olive/amber palette with green hologram light, dense subtle dithering. No player character or people in the room, no interface, no back button, no borders, no watermark. One tall portrait image, not a collage or split screen.
